purpose: Bounded offline evidence and regression fixtures. Live rendering still requires exact issue-bound claims from one fetched official document revision.

sources.title: Conditions for Claiming Input Tax
provisions: GST (General) Regulations regulations 26, 27 and 25(1) as identified in IRAS guidance
sources.effectiveDateEvidence: IRAS expressly dates specific medical and motor-vehicle exceptions in page text. The 26 October capture date does not establish the rule effective date.
sources.limitations: Complete official page response retained from the existing source capture; not a legal effective-date record. Includes all eight general claim conditions and blocked-claim details to preserve existing input-tax evidence.

sources.title: Estimated Chargeable Income (ECI) Filing
provisions: Income Tax Act 1947 sections 35(14), 35(12), 35(12A) and 43(2), only for the named categories in the page
sources.effectiveDateEvidence: The page provides general filing guidance and a worked example for FYE 30 June 2024; neither the capture date nor example is projected as a general historical or future commencement date.
sources.limitations: Complete official page response retained from the existing source capture; date-specific cases outside the page examples require period-specific evidence.

sources.title: Payments that are subject to withholding tax
sources.captureMethod: Direct public HTTP GET to the official IRAS URL; the response body was retained without rewriting.
sources.effectiveDateEvidence: The page expressly states the 1 November 2022 cost-pooling transition; it labels 17% as the prevailing rate but does not provide a complete historical rate table. The capture date is not treated as an applicability date.
sources.limitations: Full HTML response retained. Treaty-specific outcomes still depend on the relevant DTA and facts; non-resident individual/professional rules are separately addressed; the page is not a complete historical rate table.

sources.title: Withholding Tax (WHT) filing and payment due date
sources.captureMethod: Direct public HTTP GET to the official IRAS URL; the response body was retained without rewriting.
sources.effectiveDateEvidence: The page gives current general filing guidance and is marked last updated 14 August 2026; neither that update date nor this capture supplies a complete historical applicability period.
sources.limitations: Full HTML response retained. A case-specific due date still needs payment classification and dates; GIRO holiday adjustment needs the applicable calendar; other special payment rules may have separate guidance.

sources.title: Notice SFA 04-N24 — Reporting of Misconduct of Representatives
provisions: Securities and Futures Act 2001 sections 99(1)(a)-(d), 101(1); Notice SFA 04-N24 paragraphs 1, 2, 5, 20 and 21
sources.effectiveDateEvidence: Paragraph 1 expressly states that SFA 04-N24 takes effect on 1 January 2027. Paragraphs 20-21 state the transition for pre-effective-date matters.
sources.limitations: The captured PDF is the primary source. The visible-text excerpt contains selected native-extracted paragraphs 1, 2, 5, 20 and 21 only; it does not establish Investigation Report, Update Report, fund/VCC return or QDC obligations.
